notes: One documented case per vertical. value_strength: documented, general (benefit stated as a general finding, not measured for the case), or none found. Page numbers are printed pages.

cases.case: Pakistan inbound remittances credited to accounts (Egypt as comparator)

pakistan: Egypt instant network credits inward remittances 24/7 (S6 p.43)
